chatgpt_subscription.name: ChatGPT subscription
chatgpt_subscription.setup_hint: Sign in from Accounts using the installed Codex runtime.

lm_studio.name: LM Studio
lm_studio.launch_hint: Start the LM Studio local server, then detect or find models.
lm_studio.setup_hint: Load a model in LM Studio, then start its server from the Developer tab.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.launch_hint: Start Ollama before connecting. Sylvia GM does not launch it.
ollama.setup_hint: Start Ollama with a downloaded model. Use your server's address and context setting.

llama_cpp.name: llama.cpp server
llama_cpp.launch_hint: Start llama-server with an appropriate chat template and tool support.
llama_cpp.setup_hint: Start llama-server with your model and a tool-capable chat template. Match its port below.

vllm.name: vLLM
vllm.launch_hint: Start the vLLM OpenAI-compatible server before connecting.
vllm.setup_hint: Start vLLM with a chat model and tool-call parser. Enter its key only if authentication is enabled.

localai.name: LocalAI
localai.launch_hint: Start LocalAI before connecting. The port is editable.
localai.setup_hint: Start LocalAI with a chat model. Match its address and enter a key if your server requires one.

opencode_go.name: OpenCode Go
opencode_go.setup_hint: Use the key from your OpenCode Go workspace. Model access depends on your Go plan.

opencode_zen.name: OpenCode Zen
opencode_zen.setup_hint: Copy your OpenCode Zen API key from its workspace, then find models.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.setup_hint: Use an OpenRouter API key. Model limits come from OpenRouter's own catalogue.

featherless.name: Featherless
featherless.setup_hint: Copy a key from your Featherless dashboard. Your plan may allow less context than the model maximum.

openai.name: OpenAI API
openai.setup_hint: Create an OpenAI API key in your project. ChatGPT sign-in is available separately under Accounts.

groq.name: Groq
groq.setup_hint: Create a GroqCloud API key, then choose a chat model available to your project.

together.name: Together AI
together.setup_hint: Create an API key in your Together project. Select the full provider/model identifier.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek API
deepseek.setup_hint: Use a DeepSeek platform API key. Your DeepSeek chat sign-in is not an API key.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.setup_hint: Use a Claude API key from Claude Console. Claude subscription sign-in is separate.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.setup_hint: Use a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Select a model that supports tools.

xai.name: xAI
xai.setup_hint: Use an xAI API key from your team. Grok app subscriptions are separate.

mistral.name: Mistral
mistral.setup_hint: Use a Mistral API key and the endpoint assigned to your workspace.

minimax.name: MiniMax
minimax.setup_hint: Use a MiniMax platform API key. Enter the documented model ID if discovery is unavailable.

moonshot.name: Kimi / Moonshot
moonshot.setup_hint: Use a Moonshot platform API key. This uses the ordinary API, not Kimi Code.

zai.name: Z.AI
zai.setup_hint: Use a Z.AI API key for the standard API. Coding Plan keys use a separate service.

alibaba.name: Alibaba Model Studio
alibaba.setup_hint: Match the API endpoint to your key's region and workspace. Singapore is shown by default.

fireworks.name: Fireworks AI
fireworks.setup_hint: Use a Fireworks API key and the full model or deployment identifier.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.setup_hint: Use a Cerebras Inference API key and select an available tool-capable model.

custom.name: Custom OpenAI-Compatible
custom.launch_hint: Enter the exact API base URL for an already-running endpoint.
custom.setup_hint: Enter your service's API base URL and any required key. Unknown model limits can be entered under Advanced.
